title: AuditRecord
description: Immutable, append-only traceability entry for every prediction, recommendation, and human decision (FR-017, NFR-003; Constitution II). INSERT-only; 10y/5y retention per class (NFR-008); exempt from GDPR erasure (Art. 17(3)(b)).

inputsRef.description: Pointers to the inputs/evidence used (sensor windows, feature snapshots, source docs).

modelOrLogicVersion.description: Model/solver/agent version that produced the output.

origin.description: Provenance of the underlying data (Constitution IX).

retentionClass.description: PredictionDecisionAudit=10y; EnergyEts=5y. Configurable per class and per site (NFR-008).
